High-level relationships

High-level entity relationships

Mermaid source

Reading the diagrams

  • Crow’s-foot ends show multiplicity. A circle means zero, a bar means one, and the crow’s foot means many. The parent end is optional where the FK field is marked optional in the draft. The child end generally permits zero or more records. Shared primary keys and individually unique FKs limit the child end to zero or one.
  • PK means primary key, FK means foreign key and UK means unique key (UQ in the draft). Solid lines identify children through a PK/FK. Dashed lines show other relationships. Read composite uniqueness, conditional requirements and temporal constraints in the entity catalog below each domain.
  • ID and MONEY_PKR follow the draft’s logical conventions. FIELD is a placeholder for attributes without a settled type. Optionality follows the draft’s question marks. The absence of an optional marker is provisional for physical design.
  • Compact reference boxes point to the owning domain in parentheses. Follow the entity links in the catalog or cross-domain index for full attributes. FK labels identify which field implements each edge, including multiple roles to the same parent.
  • Use the zoom buttons and scroll within a diagram. The high-level view is selective. The detailed plates show every catalog entity and each resolved FK where the referencing entity is expanded.

Rules that span domains

  • Personal instructors own content through an automatically provisioned organization. Membership and branch scope gate institutional access. A user can belong to multiple organizations without gaining cross-tenant access.
  • Question identity stays stable across languages. Published revisions freeze stems, options and answers. Independent forks retain lineage. Historical paper occurrences and source citations remain separately traceable.
  • An offering selects a published course version. An approved enrollment migration records the old and new version and uses explicit lesson equivalence to preserve progress. Learners retain read-only access to completed personal results and certificates after leaving. Institutions retain authorized institutional records.
  • Official assessments freeze owner-selected marking policy. Self-practice can record a learner-selected negative-marking setting. Attempt snapshots, versioned responses, grading runs and publications preserve evidence.
  • Cross-tenant content use requires an applicable license or grant. Expiry blocks new access and preserves permitted completed evidence. Orders and payment evidence are separate from entitlement grants. Posted amounts use integer PKR paisa.

Open reference decisions

The catalog leaves some identifier columns, typed bindings and lifecycle links to physical design. The diagram keeps these open. Inferred links below use existing catalog entities where the intended target is apparent.

FieldInterpretation
assessment_eligibility.invitation_idInvitation target is unspecified. The draft does not establish whether this is an organization invitation or a distinct assessment invitation.

certificates.source_referenceCertificate evidence binding. The catalog also omits a certificate-to-template FK.
